content: Our contributions can be summarized as: 1) we re-examined and corrected an existing dataset for training and we collected a test set for evaluation with focus especially for rare senses; 2) we proposed a few-shot learning approach which combines topic information and contextualized word embeddings to solve clinical abbreviation disambiguation task. The implementation is available online; 3) as limited research are conducted on this particular task, we evaluated and compared a number of baseline methods including classical models and deep models comprehensively.
